name: Gold Path Solar
old_description: Gold Path Solar was founded after more than 20 years in the solar industry to give property owners a better way to go solar. Too many customers face confusing presentations, high-pressure sales tactics, disconnected contractors and poor communication. We built an employee-owned solar company around clear guidance, personalized system design and accountable service.
about:
Gold Path Solar is an employee-owned solar installation company based in Greenville, South Carolina. The business was established by solar industry veterans with more than 20 years of experience who sought to address common complaints about high-pressure sales, poor communication, and subpar installations. The founders structured the company around a dedicated Solar Advocate model to provide clear guidance and accountable service from consultation through activation.

The company designs and installs personalized residential and commercial solar photovoltaic systems, along with battery storage solutions. Its in-house teams manage the full project lifecycle: consultation and system design, site survey, permitting and utility interconnection, installation, and commissioning. Installations are performed by company employees rather than subcontractors, with the average residential project completed in a single day. Gold Path Solar serves homeowners, businesses, farms, and nonprofits across Ohio, Kentucky, and South Carolina.

Gold Path Solar works primarily with residential homeowners seeking to offset electricity costs and gain energy independence. It also serves commercial clients including businesses, agricultural operations, nonprofits, and commercial property owners who want greater control over long-term energy expenses and demand charges. The company tailors system sizing to each customer's usage profile, roof or site conditions, and local utility rate structures.

The company was created to differentiate from what its founders identified as the industry's top complaints: confusing sales presentations, high-pressure tactics, disconnected contractors, and poor communication. Its employee-owned structure aligns team incentives with long-term customer satisfaction. A single Solar Advocate remains the customer's point of contact throughout the project, and the company emphasizes transparent design, in-house installation, and post-activation support.
